name: Cache-aware Euler (ancestral) sampler
plain: Euler ancestral meant for use with step caches. Each step compares the new denoised to the denoised at the last anchor step by cosine similarity; if it is at least the threshold the step is a plain deterministic Euler step and the anchor is kept. Otherwise it takes one ancestral step from the anchor's x and sigma straight to the next sigma using the newest denoised, so the cheap Euler moves since the anchor are thrown away and replaced. In last_step mode the comparison is with the previous step instead of the anchor.
math:
Symbols: (x_a, σ_a, D_a) anchor; D current denoised; τ threshold.
if |cos(D, D_a)| ≥ τ: x' = lerp(D, x, σ'/σ).
else: (σ_down, σ_up) = ancestral split from σ_a to σ' with η; x' = lerp(D, x_a, σ_down/σ_a) (+ flow rescale (1−σ')/(1−σ_down)) + σ_up·s·ε; anchor ← (x', σ', D).

props.params: eta 0.5, s_noise 1, similarity_threshold 0.7, similarity_mode normal|last_step, first_ancestral_step 1
